body: Scientific reviewer amendment to my basis proposal: a LocalCostModel costWeights accessor is only an implementation declaration; a custom model can report basis A and compute with B. The corrected contained contract is an explicit SupportBasis supplied once to GraphHsmm and passed into every fallible cost and externalCost call; GraphHsmm validates or rebuilds every returned CostBreakdown against that same basis, and HsmmResult stores the restricted basis. A v4 decoder can claim invocation provenance only when its expected basis comes from an independently admitted invocation receipt; otherwise it proves internal consistency only and must say so. Please incorporate this into the still-open seven-path, fallible-API, and basis ruling. Reviewer response: msg-01M1D91CGFAJAJBE6530BP57V9.
